title: The Princess of Cleves
author: Madame de (Marie-Madeleine Pioche de La Vergne) La Fayette
description: "The Princess of Cleves" by Madame de La Fayette is a French novel published in 1678.
longDescription: Set at the court of Henry II, it follows a young heiress who marries the Prince de Clèves but falls deeply in love with the Duke de Nemours. Torn between duty and passion, she confesses her forbidden feelings to her husband, triggering devastating consequences.

authorInfo.bio: Madame de (Marie-Madeleine Pioche de La Vergne) La Fayette (1634–1693) is the author of The Princess of Cleves. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
